Hey you AWESOME, AMAZING, WONDERFUL people!!! 🤪

Welcome to The Chiropractic Biomechanic – Your Go-To Resource for Chiropractic Care, Mobility, & Injury Prevention!

💯 This channel is for chiropractic students, chiropractors, athletes, & anyone optimizing movement & recovery through chiropractic care, mobility training, & functional exercises.

What You’ll Find Here:
⚠️ Chiropractic insights for spinal health & posture correction
⚠️ Injury prevention with muscle activation & rehab drills
⚠️ Mobility & soft tissue techniques for pain relief & athletic performance
⚠️ Strength & stability training for better movement & longevity

💥 Hit that subscribe button for more strategies to improve movement, strength & recovery!

P.s. You're killin' this life!! 

📍Daytona Beach, FL
💌 Jesse.hodges@atthecorelifestyle.com

-Jesse Hodges, D.C., M.S., M.A., C.S.C.S. 
🏝️ Associate Professor (@PalmerFlorida) 
😈 Sports Chiropractor (@AtTheCoreLifestyle)
